about: Kit slots: what each of the five can carry and what every tool costs. Data for the kit screen. Reasons: balance.md beside this file. Written against the one build a7ce1d6 (src/game/kit.ts). v2 (after review): shield 3 -> 2, one smoke id, inBuild always a boolean, loadouts written as whole cards, pair names, the wall charge seam spelled out. v4 (agreed with destruction 15:58Z; v3 had this the wrong way round): with the slots rule on a wall charge comes off the card's count and only that, so the issued kit carries none; 'One wall charge' is the plain trade again, a wall in the room of both door charges. v5 (the goal's call on the tally, 20:57Z): Frag heavy is 3 stun, 4 frags and no door charge (was 2, 4 and 1): the third stun canister was the whole of its measured loss, so it pays in door charges instead. v6 (the maintainer, 10-10: "sam also has an unrealistic number of pouches. we should make him symmetric with the team"): you carry what a teammate carries, 4 pouches (was 11), and are issued one of each of your four things (was 4 smoke, 2 stun, 2 frags, 3 rounds of 40 mm); every loadout's card for you is recut to fit, and no man may carry more than 4 smoke (was 6: more than your pouches hold). v7 (the maintainer, 10-11: "feels weird that there's a limit on the whole squad when individuals have free pouches"): the squad's shared seven is gone (squad.pouches null): each teammate fills his own four and nothing else limits him but a tool's most-a-squad; what is issued is unchanged, so a run moves only once a card is filled. v8 (the maintainer, 10-12: "weird that i can't use wall charges or door charges myself, should be symmetric" · "we should just remove the max one wall charge per squad limitation. maybe we can say that it takes up two slots or something like that if that makes sense"): YOU may carry door charges and wall charges at the teammates' own prices and most-a-man (rows on your card only while the game's own-charges switch is on: owncharge.ts), and the wall charge's one-a-squad is gone — it keeps its two pouches, so a man's four hold two at most and the pouches are the only limit; nothing issued changes. v9 (the maintainer, 10-14, over a Door Kickers 2 loadout card: "we can change the slot system to be like door kickers. you have a single big slot on the bottom that can fit larger kit items and then smaller pouches for other stuff" · "i do think we should change the breaching shotgun to not take up a primary weapon slot" · "and then we should also add a dynamic hammer"): every man has ONE BIG SLOT beside his four pouches (members[].big) and a tool marked "big" rides in it and costs no pouch while the game's big-slot switch is on (kit.ts BIGSLOT) — the wall charge, the shield, the breaching shotgun (kit now, yours and a teammate's: the man keeps his gun) and the dynamic hammer (in the build, yours and a teammate's). So a man carries one big thing at most (a wall charge: one, where two pouches each allowed two) and his four pouches are all for small things. With that switch off a big tool costs its "pouches" as in v8 and the hammer has no row. Nothing issued changes: nobody is issued a big thing. v10 (the maintainer, 10-18: "we should just remove the riot shield"): the ballistic shield is gone from the game — no shield tool, and the 'Shield and shotgun' loadout with it.
unit: A pouch is room for ONE grenade-sized thing. Small things cost 1 pouch each. A BIG thing ("big": true — wall charge, breaching shotgun, hammer) rides in the man's one big slot and costs no pouch; with the game's big-slot switch off it costs its "pouches" instead (wall charge 2, the shotgun's shells 1). All costs are whole numbers.
rule: A card is legal when, for that man: sum over tools of (count x tool.pouches) <= member.pouches, every count <= tool.maxPerMan for his kind (you / mate), and tool.who lists his kind.

The squad is legal when each tool's total over the TEAMMATES WHO COME (members 1..n; never you) <= tool.maxPerSquad where one is given (no tool of this table gives one since v8). squad.pouches, when a table gives a number, also holds the same sum over those men under it; this table gives null: no such limit (v7).
A count is charged whatever else is on the card (40 mm rounds on a card with no FN2000 still take their pouches: the screen should set that row to 0 when the rifle goes).
Big slot (v9, the game's big-slot switch on): for that man, sum over tools marked big of count <= member.big, and those tools cost no pouch.
Nothing else is a pouch: rifle, pistol, suppressor, light, goggles, suit, trim.
inBuild false = priced as a placeholder only: no row until the build has the tool.
switch: The goal's rule, not this file's: the slots rule is on by default, one switch turns it off for play testing (today's free rows), and it would ship on with no switch. squad.pouches is data, not a switch.

squad.counts: a number here = a shared limit over the teammates who come (members 1..n; your 4 are your own); null = none
squad.note: null since v7: no squad limit, each man's own pouches only (the Door Kickers 2 way). Until v6 this was 7, the issued kit's total, the same whether two, three or four teammates came: the Blue pair, issued nothing, showed four empty pouches each and could fill none of them. In play the squad's stun, door charges and frags are still one pool (kit.ts kitPool): the cards decide how much goes in it. A four can now carry 16 pouches of kit against the issued 7: balance.md section 6.

tools.label: Smoke canister
tools.kit: you: Player.canisters (your card's smoke count; the Cans row's smoke half with the slots rule off). mate: his card's smoke count, none as issued; what the men who come carry is the squad's count for the order 'smoke there' on a spot of floor (squadsmoke.ts, the squad smoke part's commit; page: squad-smoke.md beside this file).

tools.label: Stun canister
tools.kit: you: Player.flashbangs (your card's stun count; the Cans row's stun half with the slots rule off); mate: MemberKit.bangs

tools.label: 40 mm grenade
tools.kit: MemberKit.shells; only a gun with the launcher fires them. A teammate's one is fired on your order (squad40.ts) and has a row on his card only where that order is in the build and the card is a tree (kit.ts mateShells): elsewhere his count is 0

tools.label: Door charge
tools.kit: MemberKit.charges: what the man brings to the squad's one count of door charges (kit.ts kitPool), you as a teammate (v8; your row only with the own-charges switch on)

tools.label: Wall charge
tools.kit: MemberKit.walls, a count. With the slots rule ON the kit staging always sets destruction's count from the cards of everybody who comes, you among them (kit.ts kitWalls): 0 as issued (no wall offered), else what the cards carry. A wall charge comes off that count and only that; door charges are never turned into one. No most-a-squad since v8 (it was 1): two pouches each is the limit, two a man at most. Destruction's whole-bag rule (a wall spends both door charges, picked at the moment) runs only with the slots switch off.

tools.label: Breaching shotgun
tools.kit: Big slot on (v9): MemberKit.big === 'shotgun' — kit, a door tool only: the man keeps his gun and the shotgun comes out for a lock (bigkit.ts). Big slot off: MemberKit.weapon === 'shotgun' (= 1), its shells a pouch.

tools.label: Optical wand
tools.kit: MemberKit.wand (true = 1). A look under a shut door (wand.ts): yours by hand; a teammate's only on your order, and his row only while WAND.mate is on (wandorder.ts; off = yours alone, as it was). As issued you carry none and your four pouches are full, so taking it means leaving a can or the 40 mm round behind. Nothing while the wand's switch is off.

tools.label: Sticky camera
tools.kit: MemberKit.cams. Yours alone: the rifle's launcher sends one to a wall, where it is one more eye on the fog of war (stickycam.ts). As issued you carry none and your four pouches are full, so each one means leaving a can or the 40 mm round behind; none without the rifle. Nothing while the cameras' switch is off.

tools.label: Sponge round
tools.kit: MemberKit.rings. The launcher's sponge round: out cold to the head, doubled over anywhere else, a noise off a wall. A row of the tree's card only (kittree.ts KITTREE: off, the count is inert and every launcher has its five). None as issued; a quiet or solo mission hands you five over your card, which take no pouch. None without a gun that has the launcher.

tools.label: Dynamic hammer
tools.kit: MemberKit.big === 'hammer' (v9; nothing with the big-slot switch off: no row, and its 2 pouches are never charged). Two blows take a lock from either face, a wedged door too; loud as the boot, never gunfire (bigkit.ts).

loadouts.name: One wall charge
loadouts.givesUp: both door charges: a locked door is the boot's, the pick's or a shotgun's. (Keeping the door charges and paying with the two frags instead is also a legal fill.)

loadouts.name: Stun heavy
loadouts.givesUp: both squad frags and one door charge; you, your frag for a second stun

loadouts.name: Frag heavy
loadouts.givesUp: both door charges: a locked door is the boot's, the pick's or a shotgun's; and the squad's frags cannot be ordered with a hostage on the floor

loadouts.name: Quiet
loadouts.givesUp: your rifle, its launcher and your stun; the squad's frags and door charges. Your stun and your 40 mm go for two more smoke (all four of your pouches full). The squad's trade is made with guns, which cost no pouches: most of the teammates' pouches stay empty because the build has nothing else quiet to carry

forTheScreen: As issued writes nothing on a TEAMMATE (kit.ts already works that way): the issued cards are legal, so the rule never fires on them. YOUR issued card (v6: one of each) is fewer than a Player is built with (4 smoke, 2 stun, 2 frags, 3 rounds of 40 mm: the plain night with no scenario, a Training lesson, and the slots rule off), so with the rule on the kit staging writes your four counts onto you and a run differs from the rule-off run by those counts and by nothing else.
The Loud set in kit.ts (one more stun on every teammate) is NOT legal under this table: Red One would hold 5 of 4. 'Stun heavy' above is its legal stand-in.

Your Cans row (four fixed mixes of six cans) is the rule-off row only: six cans are over your 4 pouches, so with the rule on your smoke and stun are two counted rows, a pouch each, and no named loadout above is one of the four mixes.
The Quiet set in kit.ts with the rule off leaves your 3 rounds of 40 mm on the card with no rifle (a free row). 'Quiet' above sets them to 0.

maxPerMan is today's row maximum for every row that exists (your smoke: 4, all your pouches hold; the rule-off row goes to 6); the shotgun is one, a wall charge two a man (v8) — one, in the big slot, with the big-slot switch on (v9).

v9: with the big-slot switch on the card has ONE row for the big slot (a choice: empty, breaching shotgun, dynamic hammer, wall charge) in place of the wall charge row and the shotgun on the weapon row. Draw it under the pouches.
'cards' in a loadout are kit.ts MemberKit fields by member index, for what is not a count.
